title: Statistically Robust Characterization of Polaron and Bipolaron Intrinsic Traps in Amorphous Silica Reveals the Role of Network Flexibility in Electron Localisation
summary: Intrinsic electron localization in amorphous silica (a-SiO2) contributes to charge trapping and defect generation in silica-based electronic materials - a phenomenon that degrades logic-device performance but can be exploited for memory applications. However, the structural distribution of one- and two-electron traps remains incompletely characterized, largely because the disordered covalent network of a-SiO2 spans a vast configurational space. To address this, we perform statistical sampling to select a representative 200-model subset of defect-free bulk a-SiO2 structures from a structurally converged parent set of 2512 models, generated via classical melt-quench molecular dynamics simulations. We then characterize the intrinsic one- and two-electron traps in this subset using HSE06 density functional theory calculations. Analysis of neutral precursor sites shows that trapping propensity is not determined by a universal O-Si-O angle or Si-O bond length; it is controlled by the accessibility of the relaxed trap geometry, requiring both local strain and medium-range network flexibility. Single electrons predominantly form edge-centred polarons on distorted SiO4 tetrahedra, with occupied states 3.1-4.3 eV below the conduction band minimum. Injection of a second electron drives stronger lattice relaxation, most commonly Si-O bond elongation leading to rupture, thereby forming threefold-coordinated-Si (Si3) bipolarons and, in some cases, Si-Si-bonded bipolaron configurations. The calculated bipolaron energy ranges are consistent with optical absorption features at 3.7, 4.7, and 6.4 eV associated with intrinsic electron localization.

AI.tldr: 本文对无缺陷非晶二氧化硅(a-SiO2)进行统计采样(从2512个熔淬MD模型中选200个代表结构)，用HSE06 DFT表征本征单/双电子陷阱，揭示陷阱形成由局部应变与中程网络柔性共同决定的几何可达性控制，而非普适键角/键长。
AI.motivation: a-SiO2中本征电子局域化导致电荷俘获与缺陷生成，影响逻辑器件性能但可用于存储；然而单、双电子陷阱的结构分布尚不清楚，主因是无序共价网络构型空间巨大。
AI.method: 经典熔淬分子动力学生成结构收敛的2512个无缺陷a-SiO2母集，统计采样选出200个代表模型；用HSE06杂化泛函DFT计算本征单、双电子陷阱，分析中性前驱位点与极化子基态构型。
AI.result: 陷阱倾向不由单一O-Si-O角或Si-O键长决定，而取决于弛豫陷阱几何的可达性(需局部应变+中程柔性)；单电子主要在畸变SiO4上形成边心极化子，占据态位于CBM下3.1–4.3 eV；第二电子引起更强弛豫，多为Si-O键伸长断裂形成Si3双极化子及Si-Si键双极化子；双极化子能级范围与3.7、4.7、6.4 eV光学吸收特征一致。
AI.conclusion: a-SiO2本征电荷陷阱源自网络几何可达性而非局部结构参数，双电子俘获驱动键断裂形成Si3/Si-Si双极化子，可解释实验观测的紫外吸收特征，为硅基电子材料与存储器件中的陷阱工程提供微观依据。

title: Thermodynamic Evidence for Multiple Field-Induced Phases in an Anisotropic Kagome Antiferromagnet
summary: Kagome antiferromagnets are predicted to host exotic field-induced phases, yet experimental identification of their thermodynamic signatures remains challenging. Here we combine specific heat ($C$) and ultrasound measurements up to 36 T and down to 0.5 K to map the $H-T$ phase diagram of the anisotropic kagome magnet Y$_3$Cu$_9$(OH)$_{19}$Cl$_8$. We show that the suppression of long-range antiferromagnetic order with field at $\sim 15$ T approximately coincides with the onset of the unconventional $1/6$ (or $1/9$) magnetization plateau previously observed in this system. The attenuation (and sound velocity) then intriguingly increases down to 0.5 K just at $μ_0H = 15$ T, and $C/T$ becomes temperature independent. Moreover, our measurements are consistent with the opening of a spin gap $Δ_0\simeq3.5\pm 0.3$ K within the plateau and reveal a further compressible (ungapped) phase beyond the plateau phase, unveiling a rich sequence of field-induced phases in this quantum magnet.

AI.tldr: 通过比热与超声测量(达36 T、低至0.5 K)绘制各向异性kagome磁体Y3Cu9(OH)19Cl8的H-T相图,发现长程反铁磁序在~15 T被抑制并与1/6(或1/9)磁化平台起始近似重合,平台内存在自旋能隙,其外还有无隙相。
AI.motivation: kagome反铁磁体理论上预言存在奇异的场诱导相,但其热力学特征的实验证据仍难以获得,因此需要系统的实验确认。
AI.method: 结合比热(C)与超声(声衰减与声速)测量,在高达36 T磁场、低至0.5 K温度下,对各项异性kagome磁体Y3Cu9(OH)19Cl8进行测量并构建H-T相图。
AI.result: 约15 T处长程反铁磁序被抑制,与该体系此前观测到的1/6(或1/9)磁化平台起始近似重合;在μ0H=15 T、温度降至0.5 K时声衰减(与声速)反常增大,且C/T变得与温度无关;平台内存在Δ0≈3.5±0.3 K的自旋能隙,并在平台之外发现进一步的可压缩(无隙)相。
AI.conclusion: 该量子磁体中存在一系列丰富的场诱导相,为kagome反铁磁体的奇异相图提供了热力学与声学实验证据。

title: Small-data physics-informed ML model for magnetic exchange based on chemical composition and structure
summary: In this paper we propose an ensemble model based on a swarm of dense neural networks, able to predict Heisenberg exchange interactions within less than 1% error. The model uses the inputs of the ab-initio Schrödinger equation, i.e. the compound structure and chemical composition. In this first work, we trained the model on a few compounds of the hexagonal manganite family and were able to infer, with similar accuracy, the J values for other compounds of the same family at randomly chosen geometries, thus showing that we accurately learned the effect of the chemical composition and structure on effective magnetic integrals J.

AI.tldr: 提出一种由密集神经网络群组成的集成模型，以化合物结构和化学组成为输入，可在1%以内误差预测海森堡交换相互作用J值，并在六角锰氧化物家族的新化合物、随机几何构型上取得同等精度。
AI.motivation: 从头计算（如求解薛定谔方程）确定海森堡交换积分J成本高昂，作者希望直接从结构+成分等ab-initio输入中快速、高精度地获得J值，避免逐体系昂贵计算。
AI.method: 构建由一群稠密神经网络（swarm of dense NNs）组成的集成模型；输入为ab-initio薛定谔方程的基本输入，即化合物结构与化学组成；在六角锰氧化物（hexagonal manganite）家族的若干化合物上训练。
AI.result: 在训练集化合物上J值预测误差小于1%；对同家族其他化合物、随机选取的几何构型也能以相近精度推断J值，表明模型确实学到了化学组成与结构对有效磁积分J的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该集成神经网络方法可高精度、可迁移地预测交换相互作用，具备替代部分昂贵从头计算的潜力；但当前仅在单一材料家族内验证，尚需扩展到更广泛体系。

title: Closed- and open-system characterization of the Yukawa-SYK model in real time
summary: Strongly correlated matter without quasiparticles is central to many-body physics, quantum chaos, and quantum gravity, motivating a considerable effort toward its realization in tabletop experiments. Two challenges remain: laboratory platforms are open systems, so conformal behavior must survive dissipation, and it must be identified through measurable quantities. We address both challenges in the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (YSYK) model, in which bosons and fermions interact as in, e.g., light-matter systems, but through random all-to-all couplings that drive the boson to criticality without fine tuning. Solving the model in real time using the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism, we treat closed and open systems within a unified framework and, in both cases, consider a thermal steady state to map their phase diagrams. In addition to the known conformal and impurity (or SYK$_2$) regimes, we identify novel high-temperature regimes in which the fermions are driven by an essentially bare boson and show that their dynamics is captured by a quadratic model with time-dependent random hopping. Across all regimes, the fermionic softening of the boson is bounded by a ``criticality budget'' determined only by the Yukawa coupling and the temperature. Coupling the boson with a thermal environment induces a mass shift that deforms the boundaries between different regimes and exhausts the criticality budget, thus imposing a bound on temperature and dissipation rate compatible with self-tuned criticality. We further introduce a set of markers built from the two-point functions that separate all identified regimes, are accessible in linear response, and require no fit of the conformal exponents. We complement them with the quantum Fisher information, deriving upper bounds with and without dissipation. These results may help characterize holographic quantum matter beyond the closed setting.

AI.tldr: 本文用Schwinger-Keldysh实时方法统一求解开放与闭合的Yukawa-SYK模型，识别出新的高温区，提出"临界性预算"约束及一组可实验测量的区分各区的标记与量子Fisher信息界。
AI.motivation: 强关联无准粒子物质是凝聚态、量子混沌与量子引力的核心，但桌面实验实现面临两个难题：实验平台是开放系统，共形行为必须在耗散下存活；且需通过可测量量加以识别。
AI.method: 在YSYK模型中（玻色子与费米子通过全对全随机耦合相互作用，无需精细调节即可将玻色子驱动至临界），采用Schwinger-Keldysh形式实时求解，在统一框架下处理闭合与开放系统，考虑热稳态并映射相图；引入由两点关联函数构造的标记，并辅以量子Fisher信息推导有/无耗散时的上界。
AI.result: 除已知的共形区与杂质（SYK₂）区外，发现费米子由近似裸玻色子驱动的高温区，其动力学由含时随机跃迁的二次模型描述；玻色子被费米子软化的程度受仅由Yukawa耦合与温度决定的"临界性预算"限制；与热环境耦合引起质量移动，改变各区边界并耗尽预算，从而给出与自调节临界性相容的温度与耗散率上界；所提出的标记可在线性响应中测量且无需拟合共形指数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为超越闭合情形的全息量子物质表征提供了框架，给出的可测标记与Fisher信息界有助于在开放实验平台上识别强关联无准粒子行为。

title: Effect of compensation on magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As
summary: The real mechanism of ferromagnetism in III-V diluted magnetic semiconductors such as Ga$_{1-x}$Mn$_x$As is still debated. The experimental results point out the realization of appreciable ferromagnetism at filling of the impurity band close to one-half that can be expressed in terms of compensation degree. Based on our recent results on the existence of two competing mechanisms of pair indirect exchange (with ferro- and antiferro alignment of Mn $d$ shells), a theory of magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As is presented. The molecular-field-like equation is derived in which the effective exchange constant contains all necessary information about material, including the Mn content, the compensation degree, the crystal coordination, and the parameters of two competing pair exchange interactions. The Curie temperature depends crucially on the compensation degree. Depending on Mn content and compensation degree, three possible magnetic phases (paramagnetic, ferromagnetic, and spin-glass-like) are predicted. However, the spin-glass-like phase in (Ga,Mn)As is apparently not realized due to the additional inevitable compensation caused by As antisites. The phase transition into the ferromagnetic state occurs not only with Mn content variation but through the change of the compensation degree as well. The new mechanism of photoferromagnetic effect is predicted and discussed in the context of possible clarification of the magnetic ordering mechanism. It is assumed that the main obstacle to a possible increase in the Curie temperature is the increasing contribution of the antiferromagnetic superexchange between the nearest-neighbor Mn's, rather than compensatory (electric or magnetic) effects from Mn interstitials, as was previously stated. The comparison of our predictions with available experimental data is presented.

AI.tldr: 提出基于两种竞争性对间接交换机制的理论，导出含Mn含量、补偿度、配位与交换参数的有效交换分子场方程，预测(Ga,Mn)As中顺磁-铁磁-自旋玻璃三相及光诱导铁磁效应。
AI.motivation: III-V族稀磁半导体（如Ga1-xMnxAs）中铁磁性的真正机制仍有争议；实验显示在杂质带填充接近一半（可由补偿度表达）时出现可观铁磁性，需理论解释。
AI.method: 基于此前关于两种竞争性对间接交换（Mn d壳层铁/反铁排列）的结果，建立(Ga,Mn)As磁有序理论，推导分子场型方程，其有效交换常数包含Mn含量、补偿度、晶体配位及两种竞争性对交换参数等信息。
AI.result: 居里温度强烈依赖补偿度；依Mn含量与补偿度预测顺磁、铁磁、类自旋玻璃三相，但As反位引起的不可避免补偿使类自旋玻璃相在(Ga,Mn)As中实际不出现；铁磁相变可经Mn含量或补偿度变化实现。预测光致铁磁效应新机制；认为提高Tc的主要障碍是最近邻Mn间反铁超交换增强，而非Mn间隙的电/磁补偿效应。
AI.conclusion: 理论预测与现有实验数据进行比较，为澄清磁有序机制及解释居里温度限制因素提供新视角。

title: Critical amplitudes of the Baxter-Wu model from MCPA and Wolff simulations: free-exponent and fixed-exponent fits
summary: The two-dimensional Baxter-Wu model belongs to the universality class of the four-state Potts model. Exact expressions are available for its energy, specific heat, magnetization, and polarization amplitudes. We use these results as a benchmark for evaluating two simulation algorithms and two approaches to extracting critical amplitudes. Microcanonical population annealing (MCPA) and the sublattice-freezing Wolff algorithm yield highly consistent estimates for the energy and order parameters when applied to lattices of comparable size. According to the exact Joyce series, the local effective exponent does not stabilize at a constant value but instead undergoes a monotonic drift. This behaviour stems from corrections to scaling, which can be expressed as a series in the cube root of the reduced temperature. As a result, these corrections decay relatively slowly, with the leading term being of relative order $|t|^{2/3}$. When performing a fit with a free exponent on an automatically identified plateau, this drift gets incorporated into the estimated exponent, introducing a substantial bias in the derived amplitudes. In contrast, a fit that fixes the exponent to its exact value and explicitly accounts for the analytic correction series delivers a close match to the known exact amplitudes. Using this refined fitting approach, we obtain estimates for the susceptibility amplitudes and the universal amplitude ratios. These values are in good agreement with predictions from form-factor calculations. Additionally, we numerically determine the leading correction coefficient for the polarization.

AI.tldr: 本文以二维 Baxter-Wu 模型的精确临界振幅为基准，比较两种模拟算法（MCPA 与无子格冻结的 Wolff 算法）及两种临界振幅提取方法，指出自由指数拟合会因慢衰减修正项产生显著偏差，而固定精确指数并显式包含解析修正级数的拟合能得到与精确值吻合的结果，并据此估算了磁化率振幅、普适振幅比及极化率的主导修正系数。
AI.motivation: 二维 Baxter-Wu 模型属于四态 Potts 普适类，其能量、比热、磁化与极化振幅有精确表达式，是评估模拟算法与临界振幅提取方法的理想基准。已有研究在有限尺寸/有限温度数据中提取临界振幅时常受标度修正影响，需要澄清何种拟合策略更可靠。
AI.method: 将微正则群体退火（MCPA）与无子格冻结的 Wolff 算法在可比尺寸格点上进行对比模拟，检验能量与序参量估计的一致性；利用精确 Joyce 级数分析局域有效指数的行为，识别修正项的幂次结构；在自动识别的平台上分别采用自由指数拟合与固定精确指数并显式包含解析修正级数的拟合，比较所得振幅；最后用改进拟合方法估计磁化率振幅与普适振幅比，并数值确定极化率的主导修正系数。
AI.result: 两种算法在能量和序参量上给出高度一致的估计。精确 Joyce 级数显示局域有效指数并不稳定于常数值，而是单调漂移，源于以约化温度立方根为幂次的标度修正，主导项相对量级为 |t|^{2/3} 且衰减较慢。自由指数拟合会把这种漂移吸收进指数估计，导致振幅出现显著偏差；固定精确指数并显式计入解析修正级数的拟合则与已知精确振幅高度吻合。由此得到的磁化率振幅和普适振幅比与形状因子计算的预言一致，并给出了极化率的主导修正系数。
AI.conclusion: 在存在慢衰减标度修正（如 Baxter-Wu 模型中 |t|^{2/3} 主导修正）的情况下，自由指数拟合不可靠；固定精确临界指数并显式包含解析修正级数是从模拟数据中提取临界振幅的正确做法。基于该策略得到的磁化率振幅、普适振幅比与极化率主导修正系数具有较高可信度，可作为该普适类及相关模型的参考值。

title: Controlling nitrogen incorporation in (Eu,Ba,Ca)TiO$_3$-derived perovskite-type oxynitrides through Fermi Level Engineering
summary: Defect states directly influence not only functional properties, but also oxynitride formation during ammonolysis. Along with structural stability and charge balance, these defects can cause non-uniform nitrogen incorporation. To address this, the recently proposed Fermi Level Engineering concept provides a powerful alternative of rationalising oxynitride synthesis. By using the electron chemical potential, i.e., the Fermi level, as a unique descriptor, this approach can predict, understand, and manipulate defect formation enthalpies and charge transition levels, subsequently allowing to incorporate defect-property correlations to the concept. This work combines theoretical modelling and experimental characterisation of barium titanium oxynitrides to explain an intrinsic, self-limiting nitridation process. Progressive nitrogen incorporation causes a Fermi level downward shift, leaving further nitrogen substitution on oxygen sites energetically unfavourable, up to 0.03 N per unit formula. We demonstrate that A-site cation substitution in Eu$_{1-x}$Ba$_x$TiO$_3$- and Eu$_{1-x}$Ca$_x$TiO$_3$-derived oxynitrides can be applied to control compensation of the additional negative charge from N$^{3-}$ and keep the Fermi level high. The Eu$^{2+/3+}$ redox couple enables substitution of oxygen by nitrogen through pinning of the Fermi level at the europium charge transition level, at $\sim$ 2.9 eV above the VBM. This allows for higher nitrogen uptake of up to 0.65 per formula unit (taken from hot gas extraction) through a more controlled process. Further incorporation is then limited by an intra-Ti(O,N)$_6$ octahedra distortion due to internal bond-angle variance. These findings demonstrate that Fermi Level Engineering provides a pathway to predict and overcome intrinsic synthetic and thermodynamic limitations in oxynitride synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文结合理论建模与实验表征，用"费米能级工程"概念解释并调控BaTi氧氮化物的自限制氮化过程，并通过A位阳离子取代（Eu/Ba、Eu/Ca）将氮掺入量从0.03提升至0.65每化学式单位。
AI.motivation: 氧氮化物合成中存在缺陷态导致的非均匀氮掺入与自限制氮化问题，传统上缺乏统一描述符来理性设计合成；本文旨在用费米能级（电子化学势）作为唯一描述符，预测并克服氮化中的本征热力学与合成限制。
AI.method: 以BaTi氧氮化物为对象，结合第一性原理理论建模与实验表征，分析缺陷形成焓与电荷跃迁能级；并采用A位阳离子取代（Eu1-xBaxTiO3、Eu1-xCaxTiO3衍生氧氮化物）调控对N3-额外负电荷的补偿，利用Eu2+/3+氧化还原对钉扎费米能级；氮含量用热气体萃取测定。
AI.result: BaTi氧氮化物中渐进氮掺入使费米能级下移，进一步N替代O在能量上不利，氮掺入上限约0.03 N/化学式单位；Eu基取代体系中Eu2+/3+电荷跃迁能级位于VBM上方约2.9 eV，钉扎费米能级并保持其高位，使氮掺入量提升至约0.65/化学式单位；随后掺入受Ti(O,N)6八面体内键角方差引起的畸变限制。
AI.conclusion: 费米能级工程可作为预测和突破氧氮化物合成中本征合成与热力学限制的有效途径，并能将缺陷—性质关联纳入统一框架。

title: Nonlinearity-Induced Suppression of Dissipation in Bath-Coupled Floquet Topological Insulators
comment: 5 pages and supplementary. Comments are welcome
summary: Topological insulators can host chiral, disorder-robust edge states that dissipate energy when coupled to an external bath. We show that nonlinear interactions enable all-optical control over edge-state dissipation in a laser-written Floquet topological insulator periodically coupled to a photonic bath. Although moderate nonlinearity enhances dissipation due to mode mixing, increasing the nonlinear strength to an optimal value dramatically suppresses dissipation by forming highly localized traveling edge solitons. These results establish engineered system-bath coupling and nonlinear interactions as a route to suppress dissipation of chiral topological edge transport.

AI.tldr: 在激光写入的Floquet拓扑绝缘体中，非线性相互作用可实现对边缘态耗散的全光调控：适度非线性增强耗散，而最优非线性强度通过形成高度局域的 traveling edge soliton 显著抑制耗散。
AI.motivation: 拓扑绝缘体的手性边缘态虽抗无序，但与外部热浴耦合时会耗散能量，如何在全光条件下抑制这种耗散是实际应用的关键问题。
AI.method: 实验上采用激光写入的Floquet拓扑绝缘体，使其周期性耦合到光子热浴，并引入可调的非线性强度，研究边缘态耗散随非线性的演化（光与热浴耦合的工程设计）。
AI.result: 适度非线性因模式混合而增强耗散；当非线性强度增大到某一最优值时，系统形成高度局域的 traveling edge soliton，耗散被显著抑制。
AI.conclusion: 工程化的系统-热浴耦合与非线性相互作用相结合，为抑制手性拓扑边缘输运的耗散提供了可行途径。

title: Intra-unit-cell Josephson scanning tunneling spectroscopy of the cuprate Bi$_{1.2}$Pb$_{0.8}$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$
summary: The predominantly $d_{x^2-y^2}$-wave pairing symmetry of cuprate superconductors is well established, yet its microscopic manifestation in local Cooper-pair tunneling remains less explored. Here, we investigate Bi$_{1.2}$Pb$_{0.8}$Sr$_2$CaCu$_2$O$_{8+δ}$, using Josephson scanning tunneling spectroscopy with a conventional $s$-wave superconducting Pb tip. We observe a zero-bias conductance enhancement whose approximately quadratic dependence on junction conductance is consistent with phase-diffusive Josephson tunneling. Atomic-resolution conductance maps and site-resolved spectra reveal a pronounced intra-unit-cell modulation, with enhanced Josephson response near oxygen sites and strong suppression near copper sites and along diagonal directions. Microscopic calculations incorporating the bilayer electronic structure and realistic Wannier-based tunneling matrix elements reproduce the observed spatial pattern through interference between pairing contributions of opposite signs. Our results reveal how the sign-changing $d$-wave superconducting order parameter manifests itself in atomic-scale Josephson tunneling, providing complementary evidence for unconventional pairing symmetry in cuprates.

AI.tldr: 该文用常规s波Pb针尖对Bi2212做约瑟夫森扫描隧道谱，观测到零偏压电导增强及其对结电导的近似二次依赖（相扩散约瑟夫森隧穿），并在原子尺度上发现库珀对隧穿具有显著的晶胞内调制。
AI.motivation: 铜氧化物超导体以d_{x^2-y^2}波配对为主已确立，但其在局域库珀对隧穿中的微观表现尚不清楚，缺少能体现符号改变配对对称性的实空间原子尺度证据。
AI.method: 以常规s波超导Pb针尖，对Bi_{1.2}Pb_{0.8}Sr_2CaCu_2O_{8+δ}进行约瑟夫森扫描隧道谱测量；获得原子分辨电导图与位点分辨谱；并结合双层电子结构与基于Wannier的隧穿矩阵元做微观计算。
AI.result: 零偏压电导增强约随结电导二次增长，符合相扩散约瑟夫森隧穿；晶胞内调制明显：氧位附近约瑟夫森响应增强，铜位及对角方向显著抑制。微观计算通过异号配对贡献间的干涉再现了该空间图样。
AI.conclusion: 符号改变的d波超导序参量确实会在原子尺度约瑟夫森隧穿中留下特征指纹，为铜氧化物非常规配对对称性提供互补证据。

title: Nonreciprocal charge transport in quantum materials: From superconductors to magnetic systems
summary: Nonreciprocal charge transport, where current flows preferentially in one direction, has become a key topic across quantum materials. This review covers some recent progress in bulk crystals, artificial heterostructures, van der Waals systems, high-temperature superconductors, and magnetic materials. The review discusses both intrinsic origins, such as band-structure effects, and extrinsic ones, including vortex motion, device geometry, and heating artifacts. A central focus is the superconducting diode effect due to its application potential, which shows different critical currents for opposite directions. The review also examines how symmetry breaking, spin-orbit coupling, and magnetic order contribute to the observed responses. However, there remain challenges when many exciting findings lack a unified picture, and the field continues to debate the relative importance of various mechanisms. The review highlights key open questions and suggests future directions, including better experimental standards and device integration. This review aims to give a balanced view of what is known, what is uncertain, and where the field might go next.

AI.tldr: 一篇综述，系统梳理非互易电荷输运（含超导二极管效应）在块体晶体、人工异质结、范德华体系、高温超导体及磁性材料中的最新进展，区分内禀与外禀机制，并指出统一图像缺失与未来方向。
AI.motivation: 非互易电荷输运已成为量子材料领域的热点，但大量发现缺乏统一图景，各机制相对重要性仍有争论，亟需一篇兼顾内禀/外禀起源、平衡呈现"已知—不确定—未来"的综述。
AI.method: 综述性分析：横向覆盖多类材料体系（块体晶体、人工异质结、范德华体系、高温超导体、磁性材料）；纵向辨析内禀起源（能带结构效应）与外禀起源（涡旋运动、器件几何、加热假象），并以对称性破缺、自旋轨道耦合、磁序为统一线索讨论超导二极管效应。
AI.result: 归纳出各体系的观测现象与机制解释框架，指出内禀与外禀效应常相互混杂，实验判据不统一导致结论可比性不足；超导二极管效应因正反向临界电流不对称而最具应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 领域取得丰富进展但尚未形成统一物理图像；未来需建立更严格的实验标准（排除加热与几何假象）、厘清各机制贡献比重，并推进器件集成，为后续研究提出关键开放问题。

title: Stochastic synthesis and degradation of arbitrary diffusive processes
summary: Target search processes are often carried out by diffusive elements that are introduced and removed at random times, causing fluctuations in the number of searchers in the system over time. For instance, proteins are synthesized and degraded stochastically in the cell, and susceptible to react with specific binding sites during their lifetime. Here we derive the density profile generated by non-interacting particles subject to stochastic synthesis and degradation (SSD) at constant rates, given a source location and an arbitrary propagator for the single, non-degrading particle. We also study the first-passage properties of these many-searcher processes, which can be deduced from the knowledge of the first-passage time distribution of a single particle. We analyse the behaviours of the characteristic reaction time and of the mean first-passage time in the limits of small and large rates. Taking into account the costs associated with synthesis leads to the existence of an optimal synthesis rate. We further generalise these results to bursty synthesis, when production events involve more than one particle at a time, as often observed in cell biology. The mean first-passage time in these situations can be significantly reduced at low synthesis or large degradation rates, as it is divided by the mean burst size in these regimes. The results presented here are applied to one-dimensional Brownian searches. Some general connections between SSD and resetting processes are pointed out as well as important differences, since SSD is associated with a distinct queueing protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了随机合成-降解(SSD)多粒子目标搜索过程的密度分布与首次通过性质，并推广至爆发式合成，指出存在最优合成速率，且SSD与重置过程存在联系但对应不同的排队协议。
AI.motivation: 许多目标搜索由随机引入与移除的扩散粒子完成，搜索者数量随时间波动（如蛋白质随机合成与降解）。作者希望定量刻画这类多搜索者过程，理解合成/降解速率对搜索效率的影响。
AI.method: 给定单粒子（不降解）的任意传播子与源位置，以恒定速率合成与降解，推导非相互作用粒子的密度分布；利用单粒子首次通过时间分布推出多搜索者首次通过性质；分析小/大速率极限下的特征反应时间与平均首次通过时间；考虑合成成本求最优合成速率，并推广至爆发式合成。
AI.result: 得到SSD的密度分布与首次通过量；存在由合成成本导致的最优合成速率；在爆发式合成下，低合成或高降解速率时平均首次通过时间显著降低，约为按平均爆发规模缩减（除以平均爆发大小）；应用于一维布朗搜索。
AI.conclusion: SSD可作为一类目标搜索框架，其与重置过程既有联系又有重要差异，因为SSD对应一种独特的排队协议。

title: Hidden Triakontadipole Order in the Triangular-Lattice Magnet CeMgAl$_{11}$O$_{19}$
summary: The absence of magnetic Bragg peaks and a broad excitation continuum are commonly recognized experimental features of a quantum spin liquid. The Ce-based triangular-lattice hexaaluminate CeMgAl$_{11}$O$_{19}$ exhibits both signatures, yet its effective model and ground state remain under debate. Experiments have variously suggested a quantum spin liquid, proximate umbrella point, and disorder-suppressed magnetic order. Here we trace these contradictions to an overlooked multipolar degree of freedom: the transverse pseudospin of the $|\pm5/2\rangle$ Kramers doublet is a rank-5 triakontadipole rather than an ordinary dipole. Analyzing the magnetization, neutron spectra, and thermodynamics on equal footing, we establish a dipole-triakontadipole XXZ model with $J_{\perp} \simeq 0.65$ K and $J_c \simeq -0.13$ K. The resulting planar triakontadipolar superfluid order is hidden from dipolar probes, explaining the absence of a magnetic Bragg peak in neutron scattering. The zero-field excitations separate into a low-energy triakontadipole wave and a broad higher-energy continuum. We further propose nuclear spin-lattice relaxation and spin-current experiments to probe the gapless excitations of this hidden triakontadipole superfluid. Our findings thus open a new avenue for high-rank multipolar physics in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets.

AI.tldr: CeMgAl11O19的有效模型是偶极-三十二极XXZ模型，其基态是平面三十二极超流序，因对偶极探针隐形而解释中子散射无磁Bragg峰。
AI.motivation: CeMgAl11O19同时具备无磁Bragg峰与宽激发连续谱，实验对此提出量子自旋液体、近伞点、无序抑制磁序等互相矛盾的图像；作者认为根源在于被忽视的多极自由度：|±5/2⟩ Kramers 双重态的横向赝自旋是秩5三十二极（triakontadipole）而非普通偶极。
AI.method: 将磁化、中子谱与热力学数据放在同一框架下统一分析，构建偶极-三十二极XXZ模型（J⊥≈0.65 K，Jc≈−0.13 K）。
AI.result: 得到平面三十二极超流序，该序对偶极探针隐形，故中子无磁Bragg峰；零场激发分为低能三十二极波与较高能宽连续谱；并建议用核自旋-晶格弛豫与自旋流实验探测无能隙激发。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以高阶多极物理统一了CeMgAl11O19的矛盾实验现象，为稀土三角晶格磁体中的高秩多极物理开辟新方向。

title: Real-Space renormalization for the drawups and drawdowns of stochastic trajectories: universality classes for diffusion processes and random walks via the scale function
summary: For one-dimensional diffusion processes with arbitrary diffusion coefficient $D(x)$ and Ito force $F_I(x)$, we analyze the statistical properties of the renormalized trajectories at scale $Γ$, where one keeps only the alternating sequence of local minima and local maxima that are separated by drawups and drawdowns of amplitude bigger than $Γ$. The elementary RG-step between $Γ$ and $Γ+d Γ$ thus amounts to eliminate the drawups and drawdowns of amplitude $Γ$, a real-space-RG-procedure that is well-known for Brownian trajectories in the context of the Strong-Disorder-RG approach applied to the disorder landscape of random models. The main result is that the universality classes are determined by the scale function $s(x)$ satisfying $D(x) s''(x)+F_I(x) s'(x)=0$ that governs the exit probabilities from an interval : all the diffusions sharing the same scale function $s(x)$ have the same statistics of renormalized trajectories, even if their initial microscopic trajectories are completely different. The simplest universality classes for diffusions on the whole line $x \in ]-\infty,+\infty[$ and on the half-line $x \in ]0,+\infty[$ are illustrated with several examples of processes, with or without steady states: Cauchy, Student, Bessel, Fisher-Snedecor, Geometric Brownian. This framework concerning diffusion processes is then adapted to discrete-time and to continuous-time random walks on the one-dimensional lattice with arbitrary nearest-neighbor jump probabilities or rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一维扩散过程在尺度Γ下重正化轨迹（仅保留幅度大于Γ的绘制/回撤分隔的局部极值序列）的统计性质，证明其普适类由决定区间逃逸概率的尺度函数s(x)唯一决定。
AI.motivation: 希望理解具有任意扩散系数D(x)和Ito力F_I(x)的一维扩散过程在粗粒化（重正化）后轨迹统计的普适性来源，将强无序重正化群（SDRG）思想从布朗轨迹推广到一般扩散过程及随机游走。
AI.method: 实空间重正化群方法：以Γ到Γ+dΓ的RG步消除幅度为Γ的绘制与回撤，仅保留交替的局部极小和极大值。利用尺度函数s(x)（满足D s''+F_I s'=0，控制区间逃逸概率）刻画普适类，并与离散时间、连续时间一维随机游走（任意最近邻跳跃概率/速率）类比推广。
AI.result: 主要结果是：具有相同尺度函数s(x)的所有扩散过程，即使微观轨迹完全不同，其重正化轨迹统计也相同，即普适类由s(x)决定。文中以整线与半直线、有无稳态的若干过程为例说明（Cauchy、Student、Bessel、Fisher-Snedecor、几何布朗运动），并推广到随机游走。
AI.conclusion: 一维扩散及随机游走的重正化轨迹统计由尺度函数s(x)经普适类决定，该框架统一了SDRG式的实空间重正化方法，并可直接推广至离散时间和连续时间随机游走。

title: Effect of molybdenum content on phase transformations during continuous heating of metastable β Ti-Mo alloys
comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, submitted to Journal of Alloys and Compounds
summary: Three metastable $β$ titanium alloys with different molybdenum contents, Ti-12Mo, Ti-15Mo and Ti-18Mo (wt.%), were investigated to determine the influence of $β$-phase stability on phase transformations during continuous heating. Electrical resistance measurement, dilatometry and differential scanning calorimetry were performed during linear heating at 5 °C/min up to 750 °C. The in-situ experiments were complemented by electron microscopy observations of specimens heated to selected temperatures and subsequently water-quenched. All alloys exhibited a sequence involving partial dissolution of athermal $ω$ phase, stabilization and growth of isothermal $ω$ phase, subsequent $ω$ dissolution and precipitation of $α$ phase. Increasing molybdenum content progressively suppressed $ω$ phase evolution and subsequent $α$ precipitation and narrowed the temperature interval associated with $ω$-related transformations. The excellent agreement between electrical resistance measurements, DSC, dilatometry and electron microscopy enabled a consistent description of phase evolution during heating and demonstrated the benefits of combining complementary experimental techniques for investigation of complex transformation pathways in metastable $β$ titanium alloys.

AI.tldr: 研究Ti-12Mo、Ti-15Mo、Ti-18Mo三种亚稳β钛合金在连续加热过程中的相变，揭示β相稳定性（Mo含量）对ω与α相变的影响，并证明多种互补实验技术结合可一致描述复杂相变路径。
AI.motivation: 亚稳β钛合金中β相稳定性对加热过程相变（ω、α相）的影响机制尚需系统阐明，且单一实验手段难以完整刻画复杂相变序列。
AI.method: 对三种不同Mo含量合金以5 °C/min线性加热至750 °C，同步进行电阻测量、膨胀仪和DSC；并对加热至特定温度后水淬的样品做电子显微观察，将原位结果与显微组织对应。
AI.result: 所有合金均呈现相同相变序列：非热ω相部分溶解→等温ω相稳定与长大→ω相溶解→α相析出。Mo含量升高逐步抑制ω相演化及随后的α析出，并收窄与ω相关转变的温度区间。电阻、DSC、膨胀与电镜结果高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: β相稳定性（Mo含量）可有效调控ω及α相变行为；多技术互补联用能一致、可靠地揭示亚稳β钛合金的复杂相变路径。

title: Aging-Improved NH$_3$ Sensing in Polypyrrole Nanotube Chemiresistors
summary: Polypyrrole NH$_3$ chemiresistors in nanotube (NT) and planar film (PF) morphologies are compared on response magnitude, limit of detection (LOD), sensitivity, and response/recovery kinetics, including the performance of the same sensors tracked over 60 days of ambient storage and repeated NH$_{3}$ exposure. In the case of fresh sensors, the time constants for the fast process ($τ_1$) is shorter in the NT than in the PF at every concentration. NT is 38 \% faster on average than PF. The slow process ($τ_2$) overlaps between two morphologies and shows no concentration dependence. The two time constants differentiate the two morphologies through aging: NT $τ_1$ and $τ_2$ decrease substantially and monotonically over 60 days, while the time constants of PF show no consistent trend. All measured sensing parameters, LOD, sensor response and sensitivity improve or at least remain stable with aging in the case of NT, while all parameters degrade in the PF case. These improved sensor performance and aging identify the nanotube morphology as the more robust and manufacturable choice for long-term NH$_3$ sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 比较聚吡咯纳米管(NT)与平面膜(PF)形貌NH3化学电阻器的新鲜与60天老化性能，NT在响应速度与长期稳定性上更优。
AI.motivation: 需要判断哪种形貌的聚吡咯NH3传感器更适合长期、可规模化的应用，尤其是老化与重复暴露下的可靠性。
AI.method: 对比NT与PF两种形貌，测定响应幅度、检出限(LOD)、灵敏度及响应/恢复动力学；用双时间常数(τ1快过程、τ2慢过程)拟合，并在60天常温储存与反复NH3暴露中跟踪同一批器件。
AI.result: 新鲜器件中NT的τ1在所有浓度下均短于PF，平均快38%；τ2两形貌重叠且与浓度无关。老化中NT的τ1、τ2单调显著下降，PF无一致趋势；NT的LOD、响应与灵敏度改善或保持稳定，PF全部退化。
AI.conclusion: 纳米管形貌在响应动力学、老化稳定性和综合传感性能上更robust、更易制造，是长期NH3传感的优选。

title: Field-free transverse response in altermagnet and topological insulator heterojunctions
comment: 7 pages, 8 captioned figures. To appear in Materials for Quantum Technology
summary: We theoretically investigate the transport properties of a topological insulator (TI) connected to two-dimensional altermagnetic (AM) leads in the absence of an external magnetic field. Exploiting the intrinsic time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets, we report the emergence of a field-free transverse differential conductivity in the resulting AM-TI-AM heterostructure. Our analysis reveals that this transverse response is highly sensitive to the orientation of the Néel vector: a finite transverse conductivity manifests when the Néel vector possesses an out-of-plane component, whereas it strictly vanishes for in-plane orientations ($θ= π/2$) under symmetric chemical potentials ($μ_t = μ_b$) due to the restoration of symmetry between the $k_y$ and $-k_y$ momentum channels. Conversely, when asymmetric chemical potentials are applied ($μ_t \neq μ_b$), this symmetry is broken, yielding a finite transverse response even for an in-plane Néel vector. Furthermore, we demonstrate that while the longitudinal differential conductivity exhibits Fabry-Pérot-type oscillations as a function of the TI's chemical potential, the transverse conductivity displays a distinct antisymmetric dependence. Notably, the oscillatory behavior of the longitudinal conductivity persists even at finite temperatures. Spatially, the transverse current contribution decays exponentially with position inside the TI region. We also find that both the longitudinal and transverse differential conductivity exhibit periodic oscillations with the junction parameter $χ_t=χ_b$. These findings provide a fundamental understanding of field-free transverse responses in spin-momentum locked boundary states, highlighting the potential of AM-TI heterojunctions for next-generation spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 无外磁场下，将拓扑绝缘体（TI）与二维交错磁（AM）引线连接，利用交错磁的内禀时间反演破缺，可产生无场横向微分电导，且其大小和符号对Néel矢量取向与化学势对称性高度敏感。
AI.motivation: 传统横向（霍尔型）输运通常依赖外磁场或磁有序，如何在零磁场条件下获得可控的横向响应是自旋电子学的关键问题。交错磁体具有动量空间交替自旋劈裂且内禀破缺时间反演对称性，为无场横向输运提供了新途径，但AM与自旋-动量锁定的TI边界态耦合时的输运规律尚不清楚。
AI.method: 理论分析AM-TI-AM异质结的输运性质：基于TI边界态的自旋-动量锁定与AM引线的自旋劈裂，计算纵向与横向微分电导；系统考察Néel矢量取向（面内/面外）、上下引线化学势对称性（μ_t=μ_b 与 μ_t≠μ_b）、TI化学势及结参数χ_t=χ_b对输运的影响，并分析有限温度效应与空间衰减行为。
AI.result: 1）零场下出现有限横向微分电导；2）Néel矢量有面外分量时横向电导非零，面内取向（θ=π/2）且化学势对称时因k_y与−k_y通道对称性恢复而严格为零；3）化学势不对称（μ_t≠μ_b）破坏该对称性，使面内Néel矢量也产生有限横向响应；4）纵向电导随TI化学势呈Fabry-Pérot型振荡且在有限温度下仍保留，而横向电导呈反对称依赖；5）横向电流在TI区域内随位置指数衰减；6）纵横电导均随结参数χ_t=χ_b周期性振荡。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了自旋-动量锁定边界态中无场横向响应的基本机制，表明Néel矢量取向与化学势对称性可作为横向输运的有效调控手段，凸显AM-TI异质结在下一代自旋电子学器件中的潜力。

title: Torsion, valley holonomy, and Berry phases of quasiparticles encircling dislocations and defect complexes in graphene
summary: We investigate the geometric phase acquired by low-energy quasiparticles encircling defects in graphene. Following Anandan, this phase is the holonomy of the Poincare connection; its translational part couples momentum to torsion, giving $P_a\int T^a$. In the Katanaev-Volovich theory, dislocation torsion is confined to the defect core. For graphene, the relevant momentum is $\hbar(τ_3\KK+\mathbf q)$. We show that an isolated dislocation yields a topological valley factor $e^{\mp2πi/3}$ when its Burgers vector $\bb$ lies outside the $\sqrt3\times\sqrt3$ superlattice, together with a dispersive factor $e^{-i\mathbf q\cdot\bb}$ for every nonzero $\bb$. The topological factor recovers the lattice result of Mesaros et al. as a torsion-flux phase; 4-8 dislocations retain only the dispersive contribution. Composing Volterra elements gives the holonomy of defect complexes. At zero net Frank angle, it depends only on the net Burgers vector. The valley flux obeys a three-coloring rule: pentagons and heptagons contribute according to their Kekule site color, whereas squares and octagons do not. Atomic models confirm that ring content alone does not fix the phase: a 5-8-5 core is invisible as a divacancy or as a dislocation with $|\bb|=\sqrt3a$, but carries flux $\pm1/3$ for $\bb=2\mathbf a_1$. The torsion trace produces no geometric phase: its vector coupling violates time-reversal symmetry, while the allowed axial coupling causes only anisotropic short-range scattering.

AI.tldr: 研究石墨烯中低能准粒子绕缺陷运动的几何相位，用Poincaré联络的完整（holonomy）描述位错与拓扑缺陷，给出拓扑谷因子与色散因子的解析结构及三色规则。
AI.motivation: 澄清石墨烯缺陷（位错、5-8-5、4-8环等）引起几何相位的普适刻画，将格点结果与连续扭转理论统一，并判定哪些环结构能产生拓扑谷通量。
AI.method: 采用Anandan的Poincaré联络完整化框架，平移部分为P_a∫T^a（动量-扭转耦合）；在Katanaev-Volovich理论中位错扭转限制在缺陷核心；动量取ℏ(τ₃K+q)；以Volterra元素复合得到缺陷复合体的完整；并用原子模型（格点计算）验证环组成与相位的对应。
AI.result: 孤立位错给出拓扑谷因子e^{∓2πi/3}（当Burgers矢量b不在√3×√3超晶格中），并总有色散因子e^{-iq·b}；拓扑因子以扭转通量相位形式重现Mesaros等的格点结果；4-8位错仅保留色散项；零净Frank角时完整只依赖净Burgers矢量；谷通量满足三色规则：五/七边形按Kekulé位置着色贡献，四/八边形不贡献；5-8-5核心在双空位或|b|=√3a位错情形下"不可见"，但b=2a₁时带通量±1/3；扭转迹不产生几何相位（矢量耦合破坏时间反演，轴矢耦合仅致各向异性短程散射）。
AI.conclusion: 几何相位主要由平移扭转通量与谷自由度决定，环组成本身不足以确定相位；三色规则与Volterra复合提供了缺陷复合体相位的系统判据，为石墨烯缺陷的谷电子学与干涉实验提供理论依据。

title: Band structure of two-dimensional graphene and of one-dimensional nanoribbons via variational quantum algorithms: from energies to wavefunction quality
summary: Simulating quantum many-body systems classically encounters exponential bottlenecks, which quantum devices circumvent by natively encoding wavefunctions. In the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, however, hardware noise constrains simulation accuracy. As a stepping stone toward strongly correlated materials, we compute the band structure of 2D monolayer graphene and 1D nanoribbons (zigzag and armchair) using a single variational workflow in the $p_z$ tight-binding approximation. Non-interacting ground states also provide essential initial reference states for subspace and warm-started variational methods to solve interacting spectra. By mapping the Bloch Hamiltonian to Pauli operators, we extract the ground band via the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) and excited subbands via Variational Quantum Deflation (VQD), validating our approach from ideal simulations to execution on physical IBM Quantum processors. In ideal simulations, the workflow reproduces exact diagonalization results with high precision, whereas hardware noise introduces energy deviations of a few hundredths of the hopping parameter. While qubit counts scale logarithmically with ribbon width, fixed-depth ansatz accuracy degrades with Hilbert space dimension. Crucially, deepening the ansatz improves ideal simulation accuracy by over three orders of magnitude but worsens energy estimates under noise, proving that practical circuit depth is bounded by hardware noise rather than expressivity. Finally, we complement energy evaluations with a wavefunction-level diagnostic measuring subspace containment. This diagnostic captures degenerate manifolds and exposes optimization failure modes disguised by energy agreement alone. Operating directly on NISQ hardware, this validated workflow establishes a controlled baseline for studying topological and strongly correlated phases in realistic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一变分量子工作流，在p_z紧束缚近似下计算单层石墨烯及锯齿/扶手椅纳米带的能带结构：用VQE求基带、VQD求激发子带，并在理想模拟与IBM真实量子处理器上验证，指出电路深度受噪声而非表达力限制。
AI.motivation: 经典模拟量子多体体系存在指数瓶颈，而NISQ时代硬件噪声又限制模拟精度。作者以石墨烯这一有望通向强关联材料研究的体系为跳板，建立可控制的基线工作流，同时其非相互作用基态还可作为子空间/热启动变分方法求解相互作用谱的初始参考态。
AI.method: 在p_z紧束缚近似下将Bloch哈密顿量映射为Pauli算符，采用单一变分工作流：VQE提取基带，VQD提取激发子带；从理想模拟逐步验证到IBM Quantum真实处理器，并辅以测量子空间包含度的波函数级诊断。
AI.result: 理想模拟高精度复现精确对角化结果；硬件噪声带来约百分之几跳变参数量级的能量偏差。量子比特数随纳米带宽度对数增长，但固定深度拟设精度随希尔伯特空间维数下降。加深拟设可使理想精度提升三个数量级以上，却在噪声下使能量估计变差。波函数级诊断能捕捉简并流形并揭示仅凭能量一致所掩盖的优化失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 实际可用电路深度受硬件噪声而非拟设表达力约束；该经实验验证的工作流为在真实材料中研究拓扑与强关联相提供了受控基线。

title: Ta-based S-I-S junctions for integrated superconducting electronics
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, to be submitted to Physical Review Applied, authors listed alphabetically
summary: In this work, we have presented S-I-S Josephson junctions with $\rmα$-Ta electrodes and a ${\rm TaO}_x$ barrier. We grew base and top $α$-Ta electrodes using seed layer engineering, showing both Nb and ${\rm TaN}_x$ are viable seed layer choices, and particularly emphasize that at room temperature a re-seed layer is required to nucleate $\rmα$-Ta for the top electrode. However, we note that the choice of seed layer can have subtle implications on the electrical tunneling behavior of the junctions. We used room-temperature probing of variable junction areas, combined with Ambegaokar-Baratoff physics, to characterize the wafer scale critical current densities. For 0.4 $μ$m$^2$ junctions, we found junction spreads as low as 2.0% across the 20 x 20 mm chip relevant for device performance. The entire process was carried out using standard industry foundry processing using 150 mm wafer tooling, which is an important step towards proving that Ta-based junctions can be implemented at scale. We have successfully fabricated and tested junctions with $\rmα$-Ta electrodes and a ${\rm TaO}_x$ insulating tunnel barrier, demonstrating that this is a material platform which merits further investigation and studies for potential application in classical and quantum superconducting technologies.

AI.tldr: 该工作采用晶种层工程在150 mm晶圆上制备了以α-Ta为电极、TaOx为势垒的S-I-S约瑟夫森结，并验证其可用于规模化超导器件。
AI.motivation: 现有约瑟夫森结多依赖Nb/AlOx等材料体系，需探索可工业规模化、性能均匀的新型材料平台，考察α-Ta/TaOx结的可行性。
AI.method: 用Nb或TaNx作晶种层生长底电极α-Ta，并指出顶电极室温下需再生长晶种层才能成核α相；通过不同结面积的室温电学测量结合Ambegaokar-Baratoff理论提取晶圆级临界电流密度，全部工艺基于150 mm标准代工设备。
AI.result: 0.4 μm²结在20×20 mm芯片上的结间离散度低至2.0%；晶种层选择会微妙影响隧穿电学行为。
AI.conclusion: 成功制备并测试α-Ta/TaOx S-I-S结，证明该材料平台具备规模化潜力，值得在经典与量子超导技术中进一步研究。

title: SrMn$_2$Ge$_2$: A metallic system with anomalous magnetotransport properties
summary: The structural, electronic, and physical properties of previously unexplored layered tetragonal compound SrMn$_2$Ge$_2$ are reported. The compound crystallizes in the ThCr$_2$Si$_2$-type structure with a crystallographic parameters $c/a$ ratio of $2.535(3)$, significantly smaller than those of the related BaMn$_2$$Pn_2$ compounds ($Pn =$ P, As, Sb, Bi), indicating enhanced interlayer interaction between the moment-bearing Mn-ions. Magnetic susceptibility measurements suggest an antiferromagnetic ground state with a high Neél temperature $T_{\rm N} > 350$~K\@. A large and positive magnetoresistance (MR) of approximately $50\%$ is observed at low temperatures, which follows a power-law field dependence with exponent $n = 1.50(8)$. Low-temperature electrical resistivity data reveal Kondo-like features. Heat capacity measurements show no signs of a phase transition below 300~K and further confirm a metallic ground state. Electronic structure calculations reveal a three-dimensional Fermi surface and suggest the presence of substantial electronic correlation effects.

AI.tldr: 首次报道层状四方化合物SrMn2Ge2的合成与结构、磁性、输运及电子结构性质：高奈尔温度反铁磁基态、低场大正磁阻及Kondo-like特征。
AI.motivation: SrMn2Ge2此前未被研究，且与已知BaMn2Pn2体系相比其c/a比更小，可能带来更强的层间Mn磁交互作用，值得系统表征其结构与物理性质。
AI.method: 采用ThCr2Si2型结构进行晶体学表征（给出c/a=2.535(3)），通过磁化率、电阻率、热容测量研究磁性、输运与基态性质，并结合第一性原理电子结构计算分析费米面与关联效应。
AI.result: c/a比显著小于BaMn2Pn2；磁化率显示反铁磁基态且T_N>350K；低温磁阻约50%且为正，随磁场呈幂律依赖（n=1.50(8)）；低温电阻率呈现Kondo-like特征；300K以下热容无相变迹象并确认金属基态；计算给出三维费米面并提示较强电子关联。
AI.conclusion: SrMn2Ge2是一种具有强层间耦合、高T_N反铁磁序与显著关联效应的层状金属，其正磁阻与Kondo-like输运行为为后续中子衍射与关联物理研究提供了新平台。

title: Symmetry-protected isolation of the quantum metric in chiral type-II semi-Dirac semimetals
summary: Quantum geometry, comprising the Berry curvature (BC) and the quantum metric (QM), underpins a wide array of topological and transport phenomena. However, in most solid-state platforms, BC and QM signals are inherently entangled, making their experimental separation highly challenging. Here, we demonstrate that the chiral limit of type-II semi-Dirac semimetals provides a symmetry-protected mechanism to cleanly isolate the QM. At the chiral limit where the spin-orbit gap $m_z=0$, chiral and $\mathcal{PT}$ symmetries strictly suppress the BC, its dipole (BCD), and the shift current, leaving the QM and its dipole (QMD) as the sole sources of the optical and nonlinear Hall responses. This pure-QM regime exhibits distinct experimental fingerprints, including a divergent longitudinal optical conductivity and a QMD-induced nonlinear Hall conductivity that exhibits a pronounced singularity as the chemical potential approaches the nodal point. Turning on a finite $m_z$ reactivates the BC channels, transitioning the system from a pure-QM phase into a mixed geometric phase. By deriving a scaling law for the nonlinear Hall conductivity, we establish a direct experimental strategy to separate the mixed Drude, BCD, and QMD contributions based on their distinct relaxation-time dependencies. Our findings identify chiral type-II semi-Dirac semimetals as highly tunable platforms for isolating and probing intrinsic quantum geometric effects.

AI.tldr: 手性极限下II型半狄拉克半金属可对称性保护地隔离量子度规（QM）信号，实现纯QM响应并给出实验分离方案。
AI.motivation: 固态体系中Berry曲率（BC）与量子度规（QM）信号通常相互纠缠，实验上难以分离，亟需能干净隔离QM的平台与机制。
AI.method: 研究II型半狄拉克半金属的手性极限（自旋轨道能隙 m_z=0），利用手性与PT对称性压制BC、BC偶极（BCD）和shift current；分析纯QM区的光学与非线性霍尔响应；开启有限m_z后推导非线性霍尔电导的标度律。
AI.result: 纯QM区表现出纵向光导率发散和化学势趋近节点时QMD诱导的非线性霍尔电导显著奇异性；有限m_z使BC通道重新激活，体系从纯QM相过渡到混合几何相；不同弛豫时间依赖关系可分离Drude、BCD与QMD贡献。
AI.conclusion: 手性II型半狄拉克半金属是隔离与探测本征量子几何效应的高度可调平台，并提供基于弛豫时间依赖的实验分离策略。

title: ConvexAD: differentiable phase retrieval with geometric regularization for high-strain, low-signal Bragg coherent diffraction imaging
summary: Bragg Coherent Diffraction Imaging (BCDI) relies on phase retrieval (PR), a non-convex, ill-posed inverse problem whose conditioning is degraded by factors like noise, partial coherence, and strain or crystallographic defects in the imaged nanocrystal. Conventional approaches, including alternating projections and deep learning methods, represent the object on a dense voxel grid, which is prone to amplitude-phase mixing and becomes increasingly ill-posed under these factors, often preventing reliable three-dimensional mapping of the particle's shape and strain. Here we present ConvexAD, a gradient descent PR model that parametrizes the object shape as a convex polyhedron, built by the intersection of half-spaces and enforces flat amplitude within it by construction. This geometric regularization eliminates amplitude-phase mixing and reduces the number of trainable parameters, hence facilitating the convergence of the PR. Implemented in JAX for native GPU acceleration and forward-model flexibility, ConvexAD is validated on simulated and experimental BCDI data, where it outperforms conventional and deep learning assisted PR at high strain, low signal, and reduced coherence, extending the conditions under which quantitative BCDI reconstruction is achievable.

AI.tldr: 提出ConvexAD，将纳米晶体形状参数化为凸多面体（半空间交集）并构造性强制内部振幅平坦，用JAX实现GPU加速梯度下降相位恢复，在模拟与实验BCDI数据上优于传统及深度学习方法。
AI.motivation: BCDI依赖相位恢复这一非凸、病态逆问题，噪声、部分相干性、应变与晶体缺陷会显著恶化其条件数。传统交替投影和深度学习方法在稠密体素网格上表示物体，易发生振幅—相位混叠，且在这些不利因素下病态性加剧，难以可靠实现三维形状与应变成像。
AI.method: ConvexAD用半空间交集构造凸多面体来参数化物体形状，并通过构造方式强制多面体内振幅平坦；这种几何正则化消除振幅—相位混叠、减少可训练参数量，从而促进相位恢复收敛。模型以JAX实现，支持原生GPU加速和灵活的前向模型。
AI.result: 在模拟和实验BCDI数据上验证，在高应变、低信号和低相干条件下，ConvexAD的重建表现优于传统相位恢复与深度学习辅助方法，拓展了可定量BCDI重建的适用范围。
AI.conclusion: 基于凸多面体几何正则化的相位恢复模型ConvexAD能有效缓解BCDI的病态性，提升在挑战性条件下的三维形状与应变重建可靠性，为定量BCDI提供了一种高效且可扩展的新方案。

title: Ferron polariton Hall effect: Deflecting optically rectified polarization with magnetic fields
summary: Ferrons are elementary excitations of ferroelectric order that can propagate and transport polarization when excited with light. Here, we show theoretically that ferron polaritons exhibit a Hall effect: an applied magnetic field generates polarization transport perpendicular to the propagation direction of a ferron polariton excited by an incident terahertz pulse. We demonstrate this effect for the example of ferroelectric SnTe using first-principles calculations and a microscopic theory of the phonon-polariton current. The direction and magnitude of the transverse polarization transport can be controlled by the polarization of the terahertz pulse and the applied magnetic field. Our results establish a route toward light-controlled directional transport of electric polarization in ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 理论提出铁电“铁振子极化激元”存在霍尔效应：外加磁场使太赫兹脉冲激发的极化传输偏离传播方向，在SnTe中通过第一性原理与微观声子极化激元电流理论验证。
AI.motivation: 铁振子（ferron）作为铁电序的元激发可传播并输运极化，但如何实现对外场（尤其磁场）下极化传输方向的可控调控尚不明确，作者希望探索光控定向输运极化的新机制。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理计算结合声子极化激元电流的微观理论，以铁电SnTe为例，分析太赫兹脉冲激发下铁振子极化激元在外加磁场中的横向极化输运。
AI.result: 发现铁振子极化激元霍尔效应：磁场诱导垂直于传播方向的极化输运；横向极化输运的方向与大小可通过太赫兹脉冲偏振和磁场调节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了在铁电体中实现光控定向极化输运的途径，为铁电极化的可调控传输提供新思路。

title: Twisting the pseudo-magnetic field lattice in periodically strained Graphene
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Corrected one authors name
summary: Periodic deformations flatten electronic bands of graphene which could host strongly correlated electrons similar to those observed in twisted graphene bilayers. The most spectacular effects of strong correlations like superconductivity or magnetism have however not yet been observed despite several experimental attempts. Here, we use tight-binding calculations to investigate the effect of twisting the periodic strain lattice with respect to the atomic lattice. We find that misaligning the two lattices kills the band flattening. We also report on the universal behavior of the band flattening by periodic strain which is controlled by a single parameter, a pseudo-magnetic field flux. Our study strongly suggests that controlling the twist of the strain lattice is essential to unlock the potential of periodic strains in graphene.

AI.tldr: 本文用紧束缚计算研究周期应变晶格与原子晶格之间的扭转角对石墨烯能带的影响，发现两者失配会破坏能带平坦化，并指出平坦化由单个赝磁场磁通参数普适控制。
AI.motivation: 周期形变可使石墨烯能带平坦化，有望承载类似扭角双层石墨烯的强关联电子态，但超导、磁性等强关联效应在实验中尚未实现，其原因不明。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚（tight-binding）计算方法，系统改变周期应变超晶格相对原子晶格的扭转角，考察能带结构随失配角的变化。
AI.result: 应变晶格与原子晶格失配会消除能带平坦化；同时发现周期应变导致的能带平坦化具有普适行为，仅由一个参数——赝磁场磁通量——所决定。
AI.conclusion: 控制应变晶格的扭转角对释放石墨烯周期应变潜力至关重要，也为解释相关实验未观测到强关联效应提供了可能原因。

title: Evidence for a Dirac Spin Liquid in the Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet from High-Precision Neural-Network Quantum States
summary: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet is a central model in the study of quantum spin liquids, yet its ground-state properties remain unresolved. We perform large-scale variational Monte-Carlo calculations using neural-network quantum states (NQSs) with kagome-geometry-aware message-passing convolution on two-dimensional tori containing up to 300 spins, and achieve exceptionally low variational energies for the kagome model. The spin and dimer structure factors show no evidence of magnetic or valence-bond long-range order. Moreover, the dominant symmetry-resolved spin and dimer correlations exhibit a common scaling behavior consistent with the emergent $SO(6)$ monopole multiplet of the Dirac spin liquid. Finally, the fidelity of the optimized NQSs with Gutzwiller-projected mean-field states increasingly favors the Dirac state over the competing $Z_{2}$ candidates as the system size grows. Together, these complementary results provide evidence for a $U(1)$ Dirac spin-liquid ground state in the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet.

AI.tldr: 利用kagome几何感知的消息传递卷积神经网络量子态，在最多300自旋的二维环面上对自旋-1/2 kagome海森堡反铁磁体做变分蒙特卡洛，获得极低变分能量，多角度证据支持U(1)狄拉克自旋液体基态。
AI.motivation: kagome海森堡反铁磁体是量子自旋液体研究的核心模型，但其基态性质（是否存在磁序/价键序，以及是否为实现中的自旋液体及其类型）长期未有定论。
AI.method: 采用神经网络量子态（NQS），并设计kagome几何感知的消息传递卷积结构；在含至多300个自旋的二维环面上进行大规模变分蒙特卡洛计算，分析自旋与二聚体结构因子、对称分辨的关联标度行为，并计算优化NQS与Gutzwiller投影平均场态（狄拉克态与竞争Z2态）的保真度随尺度的变化。
AI.result: 达到异常低的变分能量；自旋与二聚体结构因子无磁序或价键长程序证据；主导的对称分辨自旋与二聚体关联呈现与狄拉克自旋液体SO(6)单极子多重态一致的同标度行为；随体系增大，NQS与Gutzwiller投影态的保真度越来越偏向狄拉克态而非Z2候选。
AI.conclusion: 上述互补证据共同表明kagome海森堡反铁磁体的基态为U(1)狄拉克自旋液体。

title: A Resonant-Tunneling Quantum-Dot Demultiplexer for Scalable Cryogenic Single-Electron Routing
summary: Scaling quantum electronic systems such as quantum-dot spin qubits and single-electron devices is increasingly limited by the wiring overhead between cryogenic devices and room-temperature control electronics. Multi-channel quantum-dot architectures that selectively route electrons using a few shared control lines, analogous to demultiplexers in classical networks, offer a promising solution. Here, we propose and theoretically investigate a gate-defined architecture of three parallel quantum dots sharing a common source reservoir and coupled to independent drain channels. Using an analytical electrostatic model and tight-binding quantum transport simulations, we show that the device can act as an on-chip single-electron demultiplexer based on resonant tunneling in the cryogenic regime. Closed-system eigenstate analysis reveals localized orbital states in each dot, and open-system transport calculations show resonant conductance peaks when these levels align with the incident electron energy, consistent with the closed-system eigenenergy evolution. By engineering the barrier-gate spacing and the relative plunger-gate dimensions, we obtain well-separated resonances with minimal overlap between channels. Bond-current density calculations show that transport is confined to the resonant channel with negligible leakage into neighboring outputs, yielding channel selectivity approaching unity for all resonant modes. The architecture is compatible with Si/SiGe and GaAs/AlGaAs platforms and can be extended to more channels, offering a route toward programmable quantum routing and resonant-tunneling-based quantum circuitry.

AI.tldr: 提出并理论研究了由三个并联量子点共享源极、独立漏极构成的栅控单电子解复用器，利用共振隧穿实现通道选择性路由，选择率接近1。
AI.motivation: 量子点自旋量子比特与单电子器件的规模化受限于低温器件与室温控制电子学之间的布线开销，需要类似经典解复用器、仅用少量共享控制线即可选择性路由电子的多通道量子点架构。
AI.method: 设计三个平行量子点共享公共源极储池、耦合独立漏极通道的栅控架构；采用解析静电模型与紧束缚量子输运模拟，结合闭系统本征态分析与开系统输运（电导）计算，并调控势垒栅间距与柱塞栅尺寸。
AI.result: 闭系统分析显示各量子点存在局域轨道态；开系统计算在能级与入射电子能量对齐时出现共振电导峰，与本征能演化一致；优化栅结构后获得分离良好、通道间重叠极小的共振；键电流密度表明输运局限于共振通道，泄漏可忽略，所有共振模式的通道选择性接近1。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可在低温下作为片上单电子解复用器，兼容Si/SiGe与GaAs/AlGaAs平台且可扩展至更多通道，为可编程量子路由与共振隧穿量子电路提供途径。

title: Universality in Anomalous Diffusion: Power Laws and Faster-Decaying Tails
summary: Strong anomalous diffusion is often characterized by a piecewise-linear spectrum of the moments of displacement. The spectrum is characterized by the slopes $θ$ and $ζ$ for small and large moments, respectively, and by the crossover moment $q_c$ at which the slope changes. The exponents $θ$ and $ζ$ characterize the asymptotic scaling of the bulk and of the tails of the probability distribution function of displacements, respectively. Here, we adopt asymptotic theory to match the behaviors at intermediate scales. The resulting constraint explains how distributions with algebraic tails imply strong anomalous diffusion, and it relates $q_c$ to the corresponding power law. Our theory provides universal hyper-scaling relations between the exponents characterizing strong anomalous diffusion, and it yields explicit expressions for the leading-order corrections to the asymptotic power-law behavior of the moments of displacement. We also characterize finite-time corrections and propose a robust distribution-based method to estimate $θ$, $ζ$, and $q_c$. The findings are supported by numerical and analytical results for three paradigmatic models exhibiting strong anomalous diffusion. Finally, we show that power-law tails are not only sufficient but also necessary for this scenario: with a Gaussian, or generally fast-decaying, bulk and exponentially rare ballistic excursions, the spectrum of moments is single-linear, and the crossover to the apparent second branch drifts with the observation time. When the bulk is fast decaying and the tail is a power law, strong anomalous diffusion is still present, but the hyper-scaling relations among the exponents are violated.

AI.tldr: 本文用渐近理论刻画强反常扩散的分段线性矩谱，导出θ、ζ、q_c之间的普适超标度关系，并揭示幂律尾对强反常扩散的必要性。
AI.motivation: 强反常扩散通常以位移矩的分段线性谱描述（小矩斜率θ、大矩斜率ζ、转折矩q_c），但θ、ζ、q_c之间的内在联系及幂律尾的作用尚缺乏统一理解。
AI.method: 采用渐近理论对中间尺度行为进行匹配，将代数尾与强反常扩散联系起来，把q_c与幂律指数关联；推导超标度关系与矩的渐近幂律前导修正，并刻画有限时间修正，提出基于分布的稳健估计方法估计θ、ζ、q_c；在三个典型模型中做数值与解析验证。
AI.result: 理论给出普适超标度关系及前导修正的显式表达；三个模型的数值解析结果支持理论；证明幂律尾是充分且必要条件——高斯或快速衰减主体加指数稀有弹道偏移时矩谱单线性，表观第二支随观测时间漂移；主体快衰减而尾为幂律时仍存在强反常扩散但超标度关系被破坏。
AI.conclusion: 幂律尾是强反常扩散的充要条件，而超标度关系成立则要求特定主体/尾部组合；所提分布法可稳健估计关键指数。

title: Minimal model of a Plateau-Rayleigh instability of a solid binary alloy nanowire: impacts of surface segregation
summary: Minimal model and its linear stability analysis (LSA) for Plateau-Rayleigh (PR) instability of an intermixed, solid binary alloy nanowire is presented. Model accounts only for the surface diffusions of the alloy components without anisotropies of a surface energies, and for a classical thermodynamic surface segregation. Model allows to assess a deviation of a longwave instability cutoff wavelength $λ_c$ from the classical value $2πr_0$ (a wire circumference) as a function of a surface composition deviation from its equilibrium value, a wire radius, and a bulk concentration of a minority component. Results of LSA are presented for AuNi, PtNi, and CoNi nanowires, where an important distinction is that a surface segregation curve for CoNi is qualitatively different from the one for AuNi and PtNi. For each nanowire there is a sizable region of a parameter space where $λ_c<2πr_0$ and correspondingly, a fastest growing perturbation wavelength $λ_{max}$ is also less than a wire circumference. This is in stark contrast to PR instability of a single-component nanowire transporting mass by surface diffusion - in this case $λ_c$ and $λ_{max}$ are larger than a wire circumference. Strong surface segregation is primarily responsible for unusually small $λ_c$ and $λ_{max}$. Results suggest that a large number of small and closely spaced nanoparticles may emerge upon disintegration via annealing of a binary alloy nanowire.

AI.tldr: 构建了混合态固态二元合金纳米线的Plateau-Rayleigh不稳定性最小模型并进行线性稳定性分析，发现强表面偏析可使临界波长λ_c和最快增长波长λ_max显著小于纳米线周长2πr_0，预示退火时可能形成大量细小且密集的纳米颗粒。
AI.motivation: 经典Plateau-Rayleigh不稳定性（单组分纳米线经表面扩散传质）的临界波长与最快增长波长均大于纳米线周长2πr_0，但二元合金纳米线因表面成分与表面偏析效应可能存在显著偏差，需要定量评估该偏差及其影响因素。
AI.method: 建立仅考虑合金组分表面扩散（无表面能各向异性）与经典热力学表面偏析的最小模型，对混合态固态二元合金纳米线做线性稳定性分析（LSA），将长波不稳定性截止波长λ_c相对经典值2πr_0的偏差表达为表面成分偏离平衡值、线半径及少数组分体浓度的函数，并对AuNi、PtNi、CoNi纳米线进行计算。
AI.result: 对AuNi、PtNi、CoNi纳米线，均存在可观的参数区域使λ_c<2πr_0，相应λ_max亦小于线周长，与单组分纳米线情形形成鲜明对比；CoNi的表面偏析曲线与AuNi、PtNi定性不同；强表面偏析是λ_c与λ_max异常偏小的主要原因。
AI.conclusion: 二元合金纳米线退火解体时可能生成大量尺寸小、间距近的纳米颗粒，表面偏析是调控该不稳定性的关键因素。

title: Crossover duality for the quantum long-range Ising chain: perturbation theory around the short-range endpoint and a DMRG test
summary: We propose a weakly coupled description of the long-range transverse-field Ising chain near its short-range crossover at $s_*=7/4$, where the couplings decay as $r^{-1-s}$. The Ising conformal field theory is coupled to an instantaneous Gaussian field through $σχ$, extending the classical long-range Ising duality to quantum chains. The equal-time interaction generates a stress-tensor deformation that causes the velocity to run and renormalizes the dynamical critical exponent $z$. Conformal perturbation theory gives $z=1-0.720\,δ+O(δ^2)$, $1/ν=(1+z)/2+O(δ^2)$, and $ω=δ+O(δ^2)$, with $δ=s_*-s$. DMRG calculations on periodic chains of up to $128$ sites provide a consistency test using theoretical inputs for $1/ν$ and $ω$. After accounting for slow finite-size corrections, static and dynamical estimates of $z$ agree, supporting the crossover expansion at $s=1.5$ and a two-sided Padé interpolation at $s=1$, $1.25$, and $1.5$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出弱耦合描述长程横场Ising链在短程交叉点s*=7/4附近的行为，将Ising CFT与瞬时高斯场通过σχ耦合，并导出z、1/ν、ω的展开式，与DMRG结果一致。
AI.motivation: 长程横场Ising链在s*=7/4处发生短程交叉，该区域缺乏可控的解析描述，需建立量子情形下的长程-短程对偶框架。
AI.method: 将Ising共形场论与瞬时高斯场经σχ耦合，把经典长程Ising对偶推广到量子链；等时相互作用产生应力张量形变，使速度跑动并重整化动力学临界指数z；用共形微扰论计算z、1/ν、ω关于δ=s*-s的展开；再用周期链（最多128格点）的DMRG做一致性检验。
AI.result: 共形微扰论给出 z=1-0.720δ+O(δ²)，1/ν=(1+z)/2+O(δ²)，ω=δ+O(δ²)。考虑缓慢有限尺寸修正后，z的静态与动力学估计一致，支持s=1.5处的交叉展开及s=1、1.25、1.5的双侧Padé插值。
AI.conclusion: 弱耦合σχ耦合框架可自洽描述s*=7/4附近的短程交叉，理论展开与DMRG数值相符，并可用于跨s值的插值。

title: Exact Rokhsar-Kivelson points hosting first-order phase transitions in $S=1$ compass models
summary: We study $S=1$ compass models on the square and kagome lattices with bond-dependent bilinear and biquadratic interactions parametrized by an angle $θ$. For compatible geometries, we determine the exact ground-state manifolds throughout the interval $π/4\leqθ\leq3π/4$. At each endpoint, a product of on-site unitaries maps the Hamiltonian to the Laplacian of a configuration graph $\mathcal{G}$ in the $S=1$ Cartesian basis. These endpoints are exact Rokhsar-Kivelson (RK) points, with one ground state per dynamically connected component of $\mathcal{G}$. Each such state is an equal-amplitude superposition in the transformed basis and acquires configuration-dependent phases upon transforming back to the original basis. Both models possess $m=O(L)$ independent and mutually commuting conserved $\mathbb{Z}_2$ line charges, where $L$ is the linear system size, forcing a ground-state degeneracy of at least $2^m$ at the RK endpoints. Throughout the interior region, $π/4<θ<3π/4$, the ground-state manifold on each lattice is instead spanned by two product states, both annihilated by the Hamiltonian. On both lattices, each RK endpoint also hosts a first-order transition into this intervening interior phase spanned by the two product states with long-range order.

AI.tldr: 研究方格子与kagome格子上S=1 compass模型（含键依赖的双线性与双二次相互作用，参数角θ），在π/4≤θ≤3π/4区间内精确给出基态流形。
AI.motivation: compass模型因键依赖相互作用产生强阻挫与奇异相，S=1情形下的精确可解点与简并结构尚待系统刻画。
AI.method: 在每个端点用逐点酉变换把哈密顿量映射为配置图G的拉普拉斯量（S=1笛卡尔基），识别为RK点；结合守恒的Z2线荷分析与对称性论证求解。
AI.result: 两端点为精确RK点，每个动力学连通分量对应一个等幅叠加基态；两模型各有m=O(L)个独立对易的守恒Z2线荷，导致至少2^m重简并；内部区域基态流形由两个乘积态张成。
AI.conclusion: RK端点与内部相之间发生一阶相变，内部相为两个具有长程序的乘积态的叠加。

title: Higher-order interactions renormalize the thermodynamic signature of neural population codes
summary: Maximum-entropy models of neural recordings can be treated as Boltzmann distributions at a fictitious temperature $T$, with the fitted model at $T=1$. Their specific-heat peak grows with population size and approaches that temperature, which has been read as a sign of criticality. The case rests on pairwise models, yet retinal codes require higher-order interactions. The thermodynamics of a model with such interactions fitted cell by cell has not been computed. Here I compute it exactly for pairwise and third-order models of the same populations of up to $20$ retinal ganglion cells, in salamander and marmoset. The triplet terms, required by the held-out likelihood, shift the peak by more than the finite-sample bias, with opposite sign in the two retinas. The peak is lower and grows more slowly in salamander, higher and grows faster in marmoset, and lies closer to $T=1$ in both. An exact decomposition traces most of the shift to the energy variance across population spike counts. A constraint on the spike-count distribution alone reproduces all of it in salamander and over half in marmoset. A second recording of each species, re-binning, and a common-input surrogate show that the sign is set by the spike-count structure of a recording at its temporal resolution, not by species. The thermodynamic signature of a neural code is therefore set not by the data alone but by the interaction order of the model used to read it.

AI.tldr: 该文精确计算了配对与三阶（含三元交互）最大熵模型在同等视网膜神经元群体（最多20个细胞，蝾螈与狨猴）中的热力学量，发现三元项会显著移动比热峰的峰值温度，且方向在两物种间相反；热力学临界性信号取决于模型的交互阶数而非数据本身。
AI.motivation: 以往将最大熵模型视为虚构温度T下的玻尔兹曼分布，其比热峰随群体规模增大并趋近T=1，被解读为临界性证据。但这一结论基于仅含二阶（配对）交互的模型，而视网膜编码需要高阶交互，含高阶交互模型的热力学尚未被计算。
AI.method: 针对蝾螈与狨猴视网膜神经节细胞（最多20个），逐细胞拟合配对模型与三阶模型，并精确计算其热力学量（比热峰位置与高度）；进行比较以区分三元项、有限样本偏差与群体规模效应；通过精确分解将峰位移归因于群体放电计数的能量方差，并检验仅放电计数分布的约束；用第二组记录、重分箱及共输入替代数据检验符号来源。
AI.result: 三元项使峰位移超过有限样本偏差，且在两种视网膜中符号相反；蝾螈中峰较低、增长较慢，狨猴中峰较高、增长较快，但两者峰位都更接近T=1。精确分解显示大部分位移来自放电计数的能量方差；仅放电计数分布约束即可在蝾螈中完全、狨猴中过半复现位移。重分箱与替代数据表明符号由记录在特定时间分辨率下的放电计数结构决定，而非物种。
AI.conclusion: 神经编码的热力学特征不由数据单独决定，而由所用来解读数据的模型的交互阶数决定；评判临界性时须明确模型阶数。

title: Bond-valence theory is a general electrostatic valence rule
summary: Pauling's electrostatic valence rule assigns to each bond of a cation of charge $z$ with $n$ anion neighbors the strength $z/n$. Bond-valence theory replaces the equal split of valence among bonds by $s=\exp[(R_0-d)/B]$ in the bond length $d$ and takes the sum rule, that the valences at each atom add to its formal charge, as its first axiom. Here the bond valence is defined in the electron density. Atomic basins of a first-principles density are bounded by faces, one per bond critical point, and the electric flux of that density through a face is a charge associated with the bond. The fluxes leaving a cation sum to its basin charge by Gauss's law, so on this surface the sum rule is a theorem. Across 3680 oxides, halides, chalcogenides and pnictides the flux follows the bond-valence law site by site, with a median deviation of ten percent. The softness $B$ varies nearly an order of magnitude from stiff sulfides to softer arsenides. In all cases it is set by the electrostatic flux at atomic basin faces. $R_0$ then follows from the bond lengths and their differences. Anion valences equal those of bonded cations to within 5\% for most of the oxide, fluoride, sulfide and nitride sites. Transferability of $(R_0,B)$ between compounds fails in 96 of 106 families, suggesting that the softness is a local site property defined by the basin charge rather than a transferable constant of a given cation--anion pair. Eliminating $B$ by the sum rule gives $s=(z/n)^{(R_0-d)/(R_0-d_B)}$, Pauling's strength raised to a distance exponent at the softness-weighted mean bond length $d_B$. Thus, bond-valence theory is Pauling's rule with a distance exponent, and the electron density supplies the surface on which the two are equivalent.

AI.tldr: 通过第一性原理电子密度在原子盆界面上的电通量，检验并重新推导了键价理论，证明其为一种带距离指数的Pauling规则。
AI.motivation: Pauling静电价规则将价均分给键，而键价理论用s=exp[(R0-d)/B]替代等分并取求和规则为公理。作者希望从电子密度本身出发，寻找键价理论的物理基础及其与Pauling规则的统一关系。
AI.method: 对3680个氧化物、卤化物、硫族化物和磷族化物进行第一性原理计算，用每个键临界点对应的原子盆界面上的电通量定义键电荷；由高斯定理使流出阳离子的通量和等于盆电荷；逐位点比较通量与键价定律，并考察B与R0的性质与可迁移性。
AI.result: 通量逐位点遵从键价定律，中位偏差约10%；B从刚性硫化物到较软砷化物变化近一个数量级，且由原子盆界面静电通量决定；氧化物、氟化物、硫化物和氮化物中多数阴离子价与键合阳离子价相差在5%以内；(R0,B)在106个家族中有96个不可迁移，表明软度是局域位点性质。
AI.conclusion: 消去B可得s=(z/n)^{(R0-d)/(R0-d_B)}，即Pauling强度提升到某距离指数，指数由软度加权平均键长d_B决定。故键价理论是带距离指数的Pauling规则，电子密度提供了二者等价成立的物理表面。

title: Quantum Error Correction in Nearly Critical Toric Codes
summary: We investigate quantum error correction protocols for topological codes deformed away from their stabilizer limits, particularly as they are pushed towards quantum phase transitions into trivial phases. Our focus is primarily on quantum information stored within the ground-state manifold of the transverse-field toric code (TFTC), subjected to independent bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence. Although the transverse field induces strong quantum fluctuations of $m$ anyons in the ground states, we show that projective measurements of the "bare" toric code stabilizers can nevertheless be used to construct an efficient decoding algorithm which exhibits a finite threshold to both types of decoherence, even when the transverse field is tuned infinitesimally close to the quantum critical point. Our construction of the optimal postmeasurement decoders---that is, the optimal decoders assuming that the stabilizers are first measured---crucially relies on the stoquastic nature of the TFTC Hamiltonian, which affords a description of its ground states in terms of a classical lattice gauge theory. Using stoquasticity, we first prove that stabilizer measurements act unitarily on the undecohered TFTC ground states to excellent approximation, and that the optimal postmeasurement decoder can be efficiently implemented via Monte Carlo simulation of a constrained lattice gauge theory. We then construct the optimal postmeasurement decoder for the TFTC states under bit-flip and phase-flip decoherence, where we numerically demonstrate a finite threshold close to the quantum critical point. We provide theoretical evidence (without a rigorous proof) that stabilizer measurements constitute an optimal decoding strategy in this setting. For phase-flip decoherence, we further prove that the optimal postmeasurement decoding threshold is independent of the transverse field strength throughout the topological phase.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究横向场环面码（TFTC）在被推向量子相变点时、对比特翻转和相位翻转退相干的量子纠错方案，证明用"裸"稳定子投影测量配合高效解码算法仍可保持有限阈值，且相位翻转的阈值与横向场强度无关。
AI.motivation: 拓扑码通常在稳定子极限下讨论纠错，但当系统被形变（如加入横向场）接近向平凡相转变的量子相变点时，稳定子图像失效、m 任意子出现强量子涨落，此时是否还能用原稳定子测量实现纠错、阈值是否保持，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 聚焦 TFTC 基态流形中的量子信息，考虑独立的比特翻转与相位翻转退相干。利用 TFTC 哈密顿量的 stoquastic 性质，将基态描述为经典格点规范理论；据此证明稳定子测量在未退相干基态上近似幺正作用，并通过对受约束格点规范理论的蒙特卡洛模拟高效实现最优"测量后"解码器。
AI.result: 构造出 TFTC 在比特翻转与相位翻转退相干下的最优测量后解码器，数值显示在接近量子临界点处存在有限阈值；给出理论证据（非严格证明）表明稳定子测量在该情形下是最优解码策略；并对相位翻转情形严格证明其最优测量后解码阈值在整个拓扑相内与横向场强度无关。
AI.conclusion: 即使横向场调到极接近量子临界点，"裸"稳定子测量加高效解码仍能对两类退相干提供有限阈值保护；stoquasticity 是连接稳定子测量与经典格点规范理论解码的关键，相位翻转阈值的场强无关性尤为稳健。

title: Conformer diversity over quantity in COSMO-RS-based LLE predictions
comment: 9 pages. Published in Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Research (2026)
summary: Accurate prediction of phase equilibria is essential for chemical process design, particularly in systems characterized by complex intermolecular interactions. This work investigates the influence of conformer selection and sigma-profile characteristics on COSMO-RS predictions of liquid-liquid equilibria (LLE), using the tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (THFA)-methyl isobutyl ketone (MIBK)-water system as a case study. Calculations were performed at the TZVP and TZVPD-FINE levels of theory. While TZVP failed to capture the experimentally observed phase behavior, TZVPD-FINE provided substantially improved predictions. The differences are attributed to the relative importance assigned to less-polar conformers and more-polar conformers capable of hydrogen bonding. Although the TZVPD-FINE calculations reproduced the main experimental trends, the predicted organic-phase composition showed a mean percentage deviation of 5.27%, slightly exceeding the adopted 5% agreement threshold. Investigations using individual conformers demonstrated that predictions can be strongly influenced by conformer selection and that representative conformer ensembles are necessary for reliable results. Further analysis showed that diversity in sigma profiles is more important for predictive accuracy than the total number of conformers. These findings emphasize the importance of carefully selecting conformers when applying COSMO-RS to liquid-liquid equilibria involving phases of contrasting polarity.

AI.tldr: 研究构象选择与sigma-profile特征对COSMO-RS预测液液平衡(LLE)的影响，以THFA-MIBK-水体系为案例，比较TZVP与TZVPD-FINE两种理论水平，发现构象集合的多样性比构象数量更重要。
AI.motivation: 准确预测相平衡对化工流程设计至关重要，尤其是涉及复杂分子间相互作用的体系。COSMO-RS预测结果对构象选择和sigma-profile特征敏感，但相关影响尚需系统研究。
AI.method: 以四氢糠醇(THFA)-甲基异丁基酮(MIBK)-水体系为案例，在TZVP和TZVPD-FINE两种理论水平下进行COSMO-RS计算；并开展单构象及不同构象集合的对比分析。
AI.result: TZVP无法捕捉实验相行为，TZVPD-FINE显著改善预测；后者虽再现主要实验趋势，但有机相组成平均偏差为5.27%，略超5%阈值。单构象分析表明预测对构象选择高度敏感，sigma-profile的多样性比构象总数对预测精度更关键。
AI.conclusion: 在将COSMO-RS应用于涉及极性差异较大相区的液液平衡时，需谨慎选择具有代表性的构象集合，构象多样性是可靠预测的关键。

title: Many Electrons, One Determinant: Hartree--Fock Theory, Basis Sets, and Molecular Integrals
comment: 146 pages, 25 figures, 6 tables. Pedagogical chapter based on lectures delivered at the European Summer School in Quantum Chemistry (ESQC 2026). Includes detailed derivations, historical perspectives, and 18 exercises with worked solutions. Lecture slides available at https://github.com/pfloos/ESQC_2026
summary:
This chapter accompanies the lectures on Hartree--Fock theory and on basis sets and molecular integrals at the \href{https://www.esqc.org}{European Summer School of Quantum Chemistry (ESQC) 2026}. Intended for doctoral students, it develops the single-determinant description of electronic structure from antisymmetry and the variational principle to the orbital equations and their finite-basis matrix representation. Detailed derivations connect the energy functional, the Fock operator, excited determinants, and the interpretation of orbital energies. Restricted, unrestricted, and generalized formulations show how the choice of variational space affects spin symmetry, symmetry breaking, and the limitations of the Hartree--Fock approximation.
  The computational development covers orthogonalization, self-consistent-field iteration, convergence acceleration, overlap-based occupation selection, and orbital analysis, distinguishing orbital stationarity from stability. A connection to second-order Møller--Plesset perturbation theory explains the correlation-energy expression and the cost of transforming electron-repulsion integrals from atomic to molecular orbitals.
  The basis-set and integral development examines radial and angular flexibility, contraction, basis-set incompleteness, and superposition error. The Gaussian product theorem leads to one- and two-electron integrals, recurrence relations, integral screening, and low-rank representations. Worked examples and exercises with detailed solutions connect these derivations to practical calculations. Historical perspectives and explicit notation conventions provide context for the approximations and algorithms that underpin molecular electronic-structure theory.

AI.tldr: ESQC 2026讲义章节，从反对称性与变分原理系统推导单行列式Hartree–Fock理论，涵盖RHF/UHF/GHF、SCF迭代与加速、MP2关联能，以及高斯基组与积分计算。
AI.motivation: 面向博士生的教学讲义，旨在把分子电子结构理论中的HF近似与基组/积分算法，从基本原理到实用算法完整串联，并提供历史背景与符号约定。
AI.method: 以反对称性和变分原理为起点，推导能量泛函、Fock算符、激发行列式与轨道能解释；比较限制型、非限制型与广义表述对自旋对称性及对称性破缺的影响；计算层面涵盖正交化、SCF迭代与收敛加速、基于重叠的占据选择、轨道分析（区分驻点与稳定性）；并将电子排斥积分从原子轨道变换到分子轨道以联系MP2关联能；基组部分讨论径向/角向灵活性、收缩、基组不完备与叠加误差，借高斯乘积定理导出单/双电子积分、递推关系、积分筛选与低秩表示。
AI.result: 给出HF单行列式描述的完整推导链条，阐明变分空间选择如何影响自旋对称性与对称破缺，明确轨道驻点与稳定性的区别，并说明SCF、积分变换与MP2的算法流程与计算代价。
AI.conclusion: 该讲义把HF理论、SCF算法、MP2与高斯基组积分系统整合，配以例题与详解习题，为分子电子结构理论中的近似与算法提供自洽的教学框架。

title: samQEq: universal charge equilibration for molecules and conductors
summary: Charge equilibration assigns atomic charges by equalizing an atomic chemical potential built from electronegativity, hardness and the Coulomb interaction. Under one global constraint it lets charge flow without limit between molecules, which fluctuating-charge models prevent with one neutrality constraint per molecule. A metal needs the opposite: a global constraint and a hardness near zero, and there the charge operator becomes indefinite unless it includes each charge's own self-energy. Here, we present samQEq (solids-and-molecules QEq), a unified charge-equilibration package for LAMMPS that combines the two constructions in one energy functional and one matrix-free solve. An orthogonal projector imposes one neutrality constraint per molecule, and the finite-width self-energy of a Gaussian charge on designated conductor types, narrower than the conductor's own Gaussian, keeps the conductor's part of the operator positive definite at any hardness. On a gold slab carrying a water film, the operator stays definite down to the conductor limit of the model, the metal screens a point charge by a constant amount at every height beyond 4 Å, and the film's charges stay bounded under dynamics. Reciprocal-space electrostatics is evaluated inside the matrix-vector product, and three distinct shielding kernels are run-time settings. We verify the implementation by reproducing a published fluctuating-charge water model without refitting, and the native ReaxFF charge-equilibration step to approximately $10^{-9}\,e$. On a single four-V100 node the largest tested systems run at approximately twice the throughput of a 128-core CPU node. samQEq thus provides one charge-equilibration layer for molecules, conductors and the interfaces between them.

AI.tldr: samQEq 是一个面向 LAMMPS 的统一电荷平衡（QEq）软件包，用同一个能量泛函和免矩阵求解器统一处理分子（逐分子电中性约束）与导体（全局约束 + 近零硬度），在任意硬度下保持算子正定。
AI.motivation: 传统 QEq 只用一个全局约束，导致电荷可在分子间无限流动；波动电荷模型用每分子一个中性约束解决该问题，但金属需要全局约束和近零硬度，此时不含自能的电荷算子会变成不定算子。现有方法无法在同一框架内同时处理分子、导体及其界面。
AI.method: 在一个能量泛函中融合两类构造：用正交投影算子施加每分子一个电中性约束；对指定导体类型采用比导体自身高斯更窄的有限宽度高斯自能，使导体部分算子在任何硬度下正定。采用免矩阵求解，将倒空间静电计算嵌入矩阵-向量乘积，并提供三种可运行时设置的屏蔽核。
AI.result: 在金板+水膜体系中，算子直至模型导体极限均保持正定；金属在 4 Å 以外对各高度点电荷以恒定值屏蔽；动力学下水膜电荷保持有界。无需重新拟合即复现已发表波动电荷水模型，并复现 ReaxFF 原生 QEq 步骤至约 10⁻⁹ e。单个 4×V100 节点吞吐量约为 128 核 CPU 节点的两倍。
AI.conclusion: samQEq 为分子、导体及其界面提供了统一的电荷平衡层，兼具物理自洽性与 GPU 加速的高性能实现。

title: Surface chemistry as data for level-set simulation of etching and deposition
summary: Level-set simulators of etching and deposition move the surface with a velocity that depends on adsorbate coverages. These coverages are usually computed from balances solved and coded by hand for each chemistry, whereas voxel-based Monte Carlo profile simulators read the reaction mechanism as data. For the open-source level-set simulator ViennaPS, this work presents a surface model whose rate laws, Jacobian and velocity are derived from a reaction file and evaluated with ray-traced fluxes. Steady-state coverages are obtained with Newton's method and transient coverages with a conservative integrator. One compiled model is applied to eight chemistries for chemical vapour deposition, selective epitaxy, plasma etching, sputtering and atomic layer deposition. It reproduces a hand-written silicon etch model to seven significant digits at a single point and within the Monte Carlo noise in a masked trench. In a high-aspect-ratio cavity, alumina conformality is determined by a trimethylaluminium reaction probability within the measured range.

AI.tldr: 为开源水平集仿真器 ViennaPS 提出一种表面模型，其速率方程、雅可比和速度由反应文件自动推导并用光线追踪通量求解，用同一编译模型覆盖八种化学体系。
AI.motivation: 水平集刻蚀/沉积仿真中吸附物覆盖率通常需针对每种化学体系手工推导和编码平衡方程，而体素蒙特卡洛仿真器则可将反应机理作为数据读取；作者希望让 ViennaPS 也具备这种数据驱动能力。
AI.method: 从反应文件自动生成速率定律、雅可比与速度；用光线追踪计算通量；稳态覆盖率用牛顿法求解，瞬态覆盖率用守恒积分器求解；模型编译一次后复用于多种工艺。
AI.result: 单一编译模型应用于 CVD、选择性外延、等离子刻蚀、溅射和 ALD 共八种化学体系；单点复现手写硅刻蚀模型达七位有效数字，掩膜沟槽内结果在蒙特卡洛噪声范围内一致；高深宽比腔体中氧化铝共形性由 TMA 反应概率在实测范围内决定。
AI.conclusion: 反应机理数据驱动的表面模型可替代逐化学体系的手写实现，保持精度且具备跨工艺通用性，可用于研究反应概率等关键参数对共形性的影响。

title: Bicarbonate/carbonic acid equilibria in aqueous solutions: Conformational Dynamics, Ion-Pair Speciation, and Free Energy Landscapes from Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics and Metadynamics
summary: Carbonic acid (H2CO3) is connected with the dissolved CO2 and bicarbonate (HCO3-) equilibria in aqueous solutions. Its two elementary reactions in water, acid dissociation and dehydration to CO2, are difficult to resolve because both are coupled to proton transfer through hydrogen-bonded networks. In this work, we combine 0.5 ns of unbiased PBE-D3 molecular dynamics of 1 molar solution of H2CO3 with metadynamics on the O - H coordination (H2CO3 = HCO3- + H+) and the C - O distance of the leaving hydroxyl (H2CO3 <=> CO2 + H2O). These unbiased trajectories show frequent cis-cis <=> cis-trans interconversion through long-lived bicarbonate (well separated from solvated proton, H3O+, and also mediated by a short-lived three-water [H2O...H3O+...H2O] ring that acts as a solvent-shared ion pair (SSIP); only 16-23% of deprotonation events reach a solvent-separated ion pair (SShIP). Resolving ion-pairs as SSIP for proper reaction leads to an improved estimate of pKa1 from 1.1 to 2.4, toward the experimental 3.45-3.59 (measured at supposedly infinite dilution). Further, metadynamics simulations provide a dehydration barrier of 17.8 (1D) and 15.3 kcal/mol (2D), suggesting that the final product CO2 + H2O is 2.8 kcal/mol below H2CO3. Our two-dimensional free energy surface also shows that C--O cleavage proceeds through the CO2 + OH- which further goes down by 9.9 kcal/mol to product CO2 + H2O.

AI.tldr: 结合无偏PBE-D3分子动力学与metadynamics，解析水中碳酸的酸解离与脱水两个基元反应，识别长寿命的溶剂共享离子对并据此将pKa1估计从1.1修正至2.4。
AI.motivation: 碳酸的酸解离与脱水两个基元反应都与氢键网络中的质子转移耦合，难以在实验和模拟中区分开，导致反应机理与自由能/pKa等关键量难以准确确定。
AI.method: 对1 M H2CO3溶液做0.5 ns无偏PBE-D3分子动力学，并对O–H配位数（H2CO3 = HCO3- + H+）和离去羟基的C–O距离（H2CO3 ⇌ CO2 + H2O）做metadynamics，构建一维/二维自由能面。
AI.result: 无偏轨迹显示cis-cis ⇌ cis-trans频繁互变经由长寿命碳酸氢根（与H3O+分离，或经三水[H2O...H3O+...H2O]环的溶剂共享离子对，仅16-23%去质子事件达到SShIP）；按SSIP修正后pKa1由1.1变为2.4（实验3.45-3.59）；脱水势垒为17.8（1D）/15.3（2D）kcal/mol，产物CO2+H2O比H2CO3低2.8 kcal/mol；C–O断裂经CO2+OH-中间体，再降低9.9 kcal/mol。
AI.conclusion: 离子对构型与去质子事件的定义显著影响计算pKa，正确的SSIP处理使结果更接近实验；二维自由能面揭示脱水经CO2+OH-中间体分步进行，说明耦合质子转移的离子对解析对碳酸反应机理与热力学至关重要。

title: Machine-Learning Molecular Dynamics Reveals Grotthuss Transport in Concentrated Electrolytes
summary: Proton transfer is responsible for the anomalous high conductivity in acidic or basic aqueous solutions. Yet, the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the conductivity of concentrated aqueous solutions is unknown. In this work, we compute the transport properties of KOH(aq) systems with different concentrations, using Molecular Dynamics simulations with a Machine Learning Interatomic Potential (MLIP), which includes proton transfer. We quantify the contribution of the proton transfer mechanism to the diffusivities of hydroxide ions and water molecules, and the ionic conductivity and transport numbers of the electrolytes. The contribution is substantial at lower concentrations, but diminishes at very high concentrations.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用含质子转移的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）分子动力学模拟，计算不同浓度KOH(aq)的输运性质，量化质子转移机制对氢氧根离子、水分子扩散系数以及离子电导率和迁移数的贡献。
AI.motivation: 质子转移导致酸/碱水溶液异常高电导，但浓溶液中质子转移机制对电导的贡献尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用包含质子转移的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）进行分子动力学模拟，计算不同浓度KOH(aq)体系的输运性质，并分解量化质子转移机制的贡献。
AI.result: 质子转移机制对OH⁻与水分子扩散系数、离子电导率及迁移数的贡献在低浓度时显著，但在极高浓度下减弱。
AI.conclusion: 质子转移对KOH(aq)输运性质的贡献随浓度升高而降低，在浓溶液中变得次要。

title: Efficient simulations of spectra and transport for multiorbital quantum impurities
summary: Quantum impurity calculations become challenging when multiple correlated orbitals are treated explicitly, particularly in nonequilibrium steady states.
